integrity: The lower bound is symbolic. Exhaustive enumeration of all 81 labeled three-element zero-groupoids independently cross-checks the boundary but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact minimum is established only for groupoids with absorbing zero at the \(n=3\) level of term-condition nilpotency/supernilpotency. No higher-\(n\) minimum is claimed.
title: The smallest 3-nilpotent groupoid with zero that is not 3-supernilpotent has four elements
